'''Teevans''' were a species from [[Teevan (planet)|Teevan]]. Their bodies were highly flexible and able to bend in ways most [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] found difficult to impossible. They also had silver-hued skin. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] apprentice [[Tru Veld/Legends|Tru Veld]] was a Teevan.
